ratings.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable limitations; 10 exceptional across assessed use. Scores reflect observed friction/features, not win/loss or physical-device certification. Unassessed features receive no invented credit.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent and finishable assisted mission with clear progress and generous touch controls; small targets, crowded screen and uncertain selection/cover friction keep it below exceptional.
reasons.controls: Two-contact movement/firing and scene swipe worked. One right-edge tap failed and needed correction; assistance prevents claims about precise aim, sustained holds or actual thumb comfort.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, coil sequence and upload provide changing goals with readable feedback. Route assistance dominated traversal, armor/cover firing caused wasted inputs, and long-term challenge/enjoyment remains unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Rain, cool teal palette, warm floor lighting, relay machinery and cohesive title/result screens create a strong consistent atmosphere. Audio and hardware rendering/performance unassessed.
reasons.usability: Context-sensitive route/approach, threat directions, map and explicit fresh start were useful. Off-camera threats while following route and dense overlays demand attention.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo, main buttons and progress indicators are legible. Small environmental signs/map legend, distant enemies and overlapping weapon/control area are less comfortable at 844x390.

coverage.manualMoveFireDrag: Opening guard and left perimeter patrol: simultaneous MOVE and FIRE drag; target-down/sentinel-down feedback. Small drag adjustments, no demonstrated free-aim precision.
coverage.combat: Additional sentinel and deck interceptor tapped then fired; three coils disabled.
coverage.missesAndCorrections: Fired during armor; emptied magazine and held FIRE while reloading without immediate damage, then resumed FIRE after reload. No verified missed-shot count; terminal reports 100% accuracy with assists.
coverage.route: Used visible HOLD ROUTE / HOLD APPROACH for recoveries and return.
coverage.unassessed: Continuous held-burst rearming, unassisted aim precision, dash, jump, tools, map, physical thumb comfort.

helpfulMoments: Immediate TARGET DOWN feedback after opening MOVE + FIRE drag.
Changing HOLD ROUTE to HOLD APPROACH made receiver interaction discoverable.
Coil I/II/III OFF indicators and upload percent made objective progress explicit.
frustratingMoments: Small distant patrol silhouettes required careful targeting.
Route traversal turned away from surviving threats; rear/side cues required attention.
Armor firing consumed ammunition; reload interrupted final coil engagement.
